title: Two 73-Stars: 73 dots arranged as a Star of David
summary: Two identical figures, each made of 73 small Stars of David arranged in rows (1, 2, 3, 10, 9, 8, 7, 8, 9, 10, 3, 2, 1) to form a large six-pointed star, each labelled '73-Star' — one in gold, one in red.

numbers.note: number of points in each six-pointed star figure (a star number)

pictures.description: Left: 73 small blue Stars of David arranged in rows to make one large six-pointed star (hexagram), labelled '73-Star' in gold.
Right: the same 73-point six-pointed star figure made of small blue Stars of David, labelled '73-Star' in red.
